title: Business Silver Rewards Card: Purchase Protection Benefits Explained
summary: This document explains the Business Silver Rewards Card purchase protection: eligible theft or damage for eligible items purchased with the card is covered for 90 days from the purchase date, with a maximum reimbursement of $7,500 per covered claim subject to terms, conditions, and exclusions. It also details how to file a claim using receipts/proof of payment and supporting documentation, including keeping reports/repair estimates and any merchant replacement/repair paperwork.
